# Merchant Financial Advisory LLC (MFA)

> Accounting and tax solutions provider based in Princeton, New Jersey, serving individuals and small and mid-sized businesses in New Jersey, New York and nationwide. MFA Insights covers IRS/federal, New Jersey and New York tax rules and deadlines, accounting, bookkeeping and QuickBooks.

MFA provides tax preparation and filing, tax planning, bookkeeping, accrual-basis accounting and financial reporting, QuickBooks setup, cleanup and support, fractional CFO and business advisory, and audit support.
Contact: info@mfa-advisory.com, (347) 205-4468. Languages: English, Hindi, Urdu. Book a 30-minute consultation: https://mfa-advisory.com/#book

## Latest articles
- [SALT Cap 2026: The $40,400 Limit and the NJ and NY PTE Tax Fix](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/salt-cap-2026-nj-ny-pte-tax/): SALT cap 2026: you can deduct up to $40,400 in state and local taxes, less above $505,000 of income. Year-end moves plus the NJ BAIT and NY PTET workaround.
- [ANCHOR Deadline 2026: NJ Property Tax Relief Is Due Nov. 2](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/nj-property-tax-relief-anchor-stay-nj-2026/): The ANCHOR deadline for 2026 is Nov. 2. One PAS-1 form covers ANCHOR, Stay NJ (up to $6,500) and Senior Freeze. Who qualifies, amounts and who must file.
- [2027 Tax Calendar: Key IRS, New Jersey and New York Tax Deadlines](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/2027-tax-calendar/): The 2027 tax calendar: every key IRS deadline plus New Jersey and New York due dates, from 1099s and W-2s to April 15 and estimated taxes. Save it to your calendar.
- [Year-End Tax Planning 2026: 4 Dates That Can Still Lower Your Tax Bill](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/year-end-tax-planning-2026-key-dates/): Year-end tax planning 2026 in four dates: Oct. 15, Dec. 31, Jan. 15 and April 15. What to do by each one, with 2026 IRA, HSA and 401(k) limits.
- [Federal Scholarship Tax Credit 2027: The New $1,700 Credit Explained](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/federal-scholarship-tax-credit-2027/): The federal scholarship tax credit starts Jan. 1, 2027: up to $1,700 per person for cash gifts to approved scholarship groups. Who qualifies, which states, and NJ.
- [Section 179 vs. Bonus Depreciation for 2026: Year-End Equipment Guide](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/section-179-bonus-depreciation-2026/): Section 179 deduction 2026 limit is $2.56M and 100% bonus depreciation is back. How to write off equipment by Dec. 31, which to use, and the NJ catch.
- [Form 1099 Preparation Guide for 2026 Payments: The New $2,000 Rule and How to File Right](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/form-1099-preparation-guide-2026/): The 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC threshold jumps to $2,000 for 2026 payments. Who needs a 1099, the 2027 deadlines, and a step-by-step QuickBooks process to file right.
- [October 15, 2026 Tax Extension Deadline: What to Do Before It Hits](https://mfa-advisory.com/blog/october-15-2026-tax-extension-deadline/): Filed an extension for your 2025 return? Your deadline is Thursday, Oct. 15, 2026. What to file, what waiting costs, and the NJ and disaster-area exceptions.
